scope: All 93 originally missing-OSM rows in the ten assigned southern/western T-Union station files. Card city identifiers describe the lookup service region, not administrative containment.
policy: Preserve every original code and native name; use independently verified station identities, cited exact historical/full-name equivalences, or explicit BRT stop groups. No line inference from card-code arithmetic, no Wikipedia coordinates, no raw report data. Known OSM references retain the same numeric coordinates across CSVs. A station reference does not assert that passenger service is open.
